text:
Alex: uploaded perfetto + nsys captures from a Dedicated run — seeing token latency spikes after KV cache warmup. Trace: s3://redwood/traces/1893600000/trace.zip

Maria: link works. Did you run inside pod or on the node?

Alex: inside pod (GKE gpu-pool-3), unprivileged. Using nvidia-container-toolkit hooks. Command:
```
nsys profile --trace=cuda,cudnn,nvtx --output=/tmp/nsys /bin/bash -lc "python -u serve.py"
```

Jin: running nsys non-root can miss kernels if attach fails. Any nsys stdout in bundle?

Alex: yes, included nsys.log in the bundle. Perfetto shows blocking region ~80ms then many tiny GEMM launches.

Sylvia: kernel selector flip: fused_gemm -> fallback_gemm in that window. Batch sizes also collapse from ~48 -> ~5.

Maria: might be batching heuristic oscillation; we moved to latency-target bins.

Jin: small batches change tiling and increase launch overhead. But what's causing the initial block?

Alex: perfetto shows epoll_wait on fd 56 for ~80ms before the small batches.

Maria: fd 56 probably RPC socket to KV cache or driver attach. Check kube events.

oncall-bot: kube-events: pod/redwood-serve-qa container redwood-serve had OOMKilled restart ~00:00:22 before trace start.

Jin: OOM before capture can leave sockets/files owned by root (e.g., /run/nvidia/*). That can block driver attach in non-root pods.

Alex: confirmed: /run/nvidia/driver.sock is root:root mode 600; our serve user is uid 1001.

Sylvia: that explains blocked attach -> epoll waiting -> batching hysteresis leading to kernel fallback and token stalls.

Maria: short-term: run profiling pods privileged or as root. Mid-term: use fsGroup or initContainer to chown /run/nvidia for profiling jobs.

Jin: also add client-side fallback: if driver attach fails, avoid long blocking backoffs. For CI, add test ensuring nsys captures kernels in profiling image.

Alex: I spun a privileged debug pod and re-ran nsys: fused_gemm stays consistent, no epoll wait.

Sylvia: runtime fix: add hysteresis to batching decision (e.g., wait 250ms or N requests before switching) and emit batch seq-length histograms.

Maria: infra/doc action: add note about nvidia-container-toolkit socket perms and example profiling manifest with runAsUser: 0 and fsGroup.

Alex: filing RED-7201 with traces and logs; will open PRs for (1) k8s profiling manifest + docs, (2) batching hysteresis + telemetry. Will re-run non-priv test after fsGroup change.

Jin: when sharing traces, include nsys stdout/stderr and exact command/env (LD_PRELOAD etc.)

Alex: added to ticket. Artifacts: s3://redwood/traces/1893600000/trace.zip and s3://redwood/traces/1893600000/nsys.log

Sylvia: ping me when new trace is up, I'll run kernel-selector sim.

Alex: will do. Thanks :thumbsup:
